name: rabble-nebula
description: Entropy-driven embeddable JS rendering engine for the RaBbLE ecosystem

scripts.build: npm run build:iife && npm run build:esm
scripts.build:versioned: VERSION=${npm_config_version:-v0.0.0.0} && npm run build && mkdir -p dist/$VERSION && cp dist/nebula.iife.js dist/nebula.iife.js.map dist/nebula.esm.js dist/$VERSION/ 2>/dev/null; echo "Built → dist/$VERSION/"
